summary: Backend admin allowlist and password values were updated/migrated, and the signup UI appears to drop an admin special-password field; however, the diff summary still indicates an Internet Identity login screen/cleanup remains in the active frontend, which conflicts with the requirement to use only local-session auth. Several additional frontend/UI and feature changes appear unrelated to the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the app uses only local-session authentication in the user experience (no Internet Identity login prompts/redirects), and remove any remaining Internet Identity-dependent auth flow from non-immutable frontend code paths.
missing_requirements.reason: Diff summary explicitly still describes an Internet Identity login screen and Internet Identity cleanup logic in the app, indicating II UI/flow remains present rather than fully removed from the active UX.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt ("frontend/src/App.tsx": "...invoking Internet Identity cleanup on mount...")

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove the "admin special password" requirement from the admin signup UX and backend gate so that admin-eligible users are not blocked by an extra special-password step during signup.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend appears to remove the special-password field, but the backend portion of removing the password gate cannot be confirmed from the provided backend diff; adminSignupPassword is still present/set in backend code and migration, which suggests password gating may still exist somewhere.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (notes frontend signups use `signupWithRole` "without password parameter", but no backend signupWithRole gating behavior is shown)
